checks.title: Out-of-stock exposure in active surfaces
checks.detection_logic: Products with zero/negative available stock currently present in recommendation frames, product collections, or scheduled campaign content.
checks.failure_behavior: PASS required; FAIL blocks dependent pilot only; excluded from headline DCS

checks.title: Replenishment input completeness
checks.detection_logic: For replenishment-eligible categories: product usage-cycle data (pack size, expected consumption days) present as catalog/detail inputs; coverage of the replenishment-candidate assortment.
checks.failure_behavior: PASS required; FAIL blocks dependent pilot only; excluded from headline DCS

checks.failure_behavior: PASS required; FAIL blocks dependent pilot only; excluded from headline DCS

checks.title: Coupon and discount consistency
checks.detection_logic: Coupons issued via Manago (addContactCoupon) vs discount codes existing/valid in Shopify; redemption events flowing back; expired codes still being sent.
checks.failure_behavior: PASS required; FAIL blocks dependent pilot only; excluded from headline DCS

checks.title: Date-prefixed detail validity
checks.detection_logic: All date.-prefixed details parse as valid dates; plausibility window; coverage for details that proximity-triggered automations depend on. IMPORTANT (verify vs Manago docs before build): Manago's proximity trigger is 'Date from dictionary detail approaching' — confirm whether the reorder date must be written as a standard date. detail or a dictionary detail for the trigger to read it. Klints must write klints_next_refill as the EXACT type the trigger consumes, or UC-11/14/38/39 never fire.
checks.failure_behavior: PASS required; FAIL blocks dependent pilot only; excluded from headline DCS

checks.title: RFM computability coverage
checks.detection_logic: Share of contacts with RFM segment assigned; unassigned share decomposed into no-purchase-history (legitimate) vs missing-events (LE-01/14 damage).
checks.failure_behavior: PASS required; FAIL blocks dependent pilot only; excluded from headline DCS
